scope: Prospective group observation: explicit palm visual >=2048 pixels and each of five finger families >=512 in at least one of three pairwise >=30deg views; base same-rigid >200 each. Every native hand body must reach64 pixels in a selected view; all gaps retained. Three supplementary wide views cover all four arms, both tables and forearm/wrist2 visible pixels.
